config.markdown: Fires when a row is added to New Hires. Site/list are set directly here, reselect them in this trigger to point at your own list.

Configuration variables:

• HRNotifyEmail — where HR gets alerted (missing data / no audience match)

• WelcomeLinksSite / WelcomeLinksList — where role-based links live

Replace with your own site, list, and mailbox before use.

Onboarding Agent — runs after Match Audience, trusts its result completely.

• Stops if Packet sent is already set

• Alerts HR and stops if any required field was missing

• Otherwise: gets Welcome Links filtered to Everyone + matched audience (SharePoint does the filtering, not the agent), emails the hire (Cc manager), also alerts HR if no audience matched, then stamps Packet sent

config.markdown:
Match Audience — read-only (one Get items call, no writes). Matches Job title to an existing Welcome Links audience, or null if none fit.  

Outputs only {audience, matched_on, missing_fields}.
Expected columns: Preferred name, Work email, Job title, Start date, Manager email, Packet sent.
